items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Is it Clayborne? I don't know.

ctx.x: They saw them now. They got a big statue up there or somebody.
Is it Clayborne? I don't know.
Either Ivorville or Bienville or somebody. Yeah, it was one of those. I think one of the guys that discovered or founded New Orleans.
